description: This file contains a series of tests for the 'bundle-uri' functionality, specifically testing the 'bundle_uri_parse_line()', 'parse-config', and other related methods. It verifies parsing behavior, error handling, and edge cases for bundle URI configurations within a shell scripting testing framework.

methods.name: bundle_uri_parse_line
